app-update.title: A new version is available

badges.source-tooltip: Data for the Hungarian market comes from the ENTSO-E platform.

balancing.title: Balancing energy bid ladder
balancing.description: Inspect Hungary’s published aFRR and mFRR offers, the marginal price at a selected cumulative volume, and its 24-hour history.

ladder-chart.title: Bid price ladder
ladder-chart.description: Published offer price by cumulative volume; target {{ target }} MW is highlighted.
ladder-chart.accessible: Step chart of balancing offer price by cumulative megawatts.

history-chart.title: 24-hour target price history
history-chart.description: Price covering {{ target }} MW in each delivery quarter. Gaps indicate missing or insufficient offers.
history-chart.accessible: Line chart of the selected balancing target price over 24 hours.

bid-table.title: Published bid detail
bid-table.description: Eligible bids are shown in ladder order; excluded bids follow without a cumulative value.

history-table.title: Target price intervals
history-table.description: Completeness and available volume for every quarter in the history window.

balancing.method-note: This is an analytical ordering of published offers, not an activation simulation. Linked or exclusive constraints are not optimized and currencies are not converted.

not-found.description: The page you’re looking for doesn’t exist or may have moved.
not-found.title: Page not found

pwa.reload-description: A cached application file can no longer be recovered.
pwa.reload-title: The application needs to be reloaded

badges.market-tooltip: Data is shown for Hungary in the Europe/Budapest market time zone.

solar.title: Solar production
solar.description: Compare Hungary’s published day-ahead solar forecast with actual generation and quantify the forecast error.
solar.method-note: Deviation is actual minus forecast. Missing intervals remain gaps and are never interpreted as zero.

freshness.message: The latest actual interval ended at {{ time }}. ENTSO-E has not published newer actual data yet.
freshness.importer-delayed-message: The import service is delayed. Its last successful solar poll was at {{ time }}.
freshness.importer-offline-message: The import service is not updating data. Its last successful solar poll was at {{ time }}.

production-chart.title: Forecast vs. actual
production-chart.description: Quarter-hour solar generation in MW, Hungary market time.
production-chart.accessible: Line chart comparing actual and forecast solar production.

deviation-chart.title: Forecast deviation
deviation-chart.description: Positive values mean production above forecast; negative values mean below forecast.
deviation-chart.accessible: Bar chart of solar forecast deviations.

table.title: Interval detail
table.description: Exact source-aligned values for every delivery interval.

validation.maximum-length: The length should be at most {{value}} characters
validation.minimum-length: The length should be at least {{value}} characters

badge-tooltips.complete: The dataset contains all expected records for the selected interval.

connection.connecting: The application is connecting to receive automatic data updates.
connection.delayed: The source data or its updates are delayed.
connection.live: Live updates are connected and new data loads automatically.
connection.offline: Live updates are unavailable; the displayed data will not refresh automatically.

badge-tooltips.incomplete: Some expected records are missing; the results may be incomplete.

market.load-error: Fresh data could not be loaded. The last valid snapshot remains visible.
market.no-data: No data is available for this selection.
